title: [review] lichend.rs: Unchecked read_exact from /dev/urandom
description: The result of `std::io::Read::read_exact(&mut f, &mut b)` is discarded with `let _ = ...`. If read_exact fails (e.g., interrupted by signal, partial read), the seed buffer remains partially or fully zeroed. This produces a predictable cryptographic identity, completely compromising node authentication and encryption.
close_reason: Fixed: Added error handling for read_exact from /dev/urandom. If the read fails, the daemon now logs the error and exits with code 1 instead of continuing with a potentially zeroed seed buffer.
